description: TrendPulse is a Python MCP server for Google News research and Google Trends analytics: search articles, extract content, monitor trending terms, compare keyword interest and growth, inspect regional demand, and discover related queries and topics.

notes: The community stdio server requires no authentication. Self-hosted Streamable HTTP deployments can optionally enable Clerk OAuth; no public DigestSEO-hosted endpoint is claimed here.

clients: ChatGPT or Codex when connected to a self-hosted Streamable HTTP deployment

notes: Metadata matches the public README and MCP Registry-compatible server.json. The community server is available now; the separate managed DigestSEO-hosted surface is still documented as unreleased.
